2026_05_NYG_WAS.headline: Daniels returns to face New York’s rush as Winston confronts Washington’s disguises
2026_05_NYG_WAS.paragraph1: Jameis Winston must identify Washington’s blitzes before committing to intermediate throws, because Dan Quinn can disguise pressure and force hurried releases. New York can counter with Isaiah Likely on quick outlets while Abdul Carter and Arvell Reese test the Commanders’ protection from the other side. Jayden Daniels has been cleared to start for Washington, but with Stefon Diggs sidelined and Terry McLaurin questionable, moving the launch point and relying on short targets could help him avoid New York’s rush. Both offenses must protect their quarterback without sacrificing downfield chances.
2026_05_NYG_WAS.model_rationale: Washington can vary its pressure to test Winston's decisions, while New York's edge rush threatens Daniels on long dropbacks. Quicker throws and protection adjustments offer both teams tactical answers.
